noun_definition: web refers to the online platform where users can interact with the application, specifically in the context of selecting emojis within conversations.
Emoji refers to a graphical representation used in the application that allows users to select different categories during conversations.
Tooltip refers to a small informational box that should appear when hovering over a category picker, displaying the name of the category.

Category picker refers to the interface element in the emoji selection menu that allows users to choose a specific category of emojis, which should display a tooltip with the category name when hovered over.
